# Sales call with Rajasekhar Jasthi from Skill Quotient
Date: 2026-11-17 | Duration: 20.719999313354492m

## Summary
SQ Skill Group is pursuing a UAE RFP requiring an on-premises A/B testing platform for a two-year project, with the proposal due within two weeks. Rajasekhar and Sagar expressed interest in partnering with GrowthBook to resell and manage licenses, while SQ Skill Group would remain client-facing and implement the solution if selected. GrowthBook’s self-hosted deployment appears relevant, but database compatibility, air-gapped licensing, MAF requirements, security, and critical-issue support still require validation. GrowthBook requested RFP excerpts, database details, user counts, licensing information, and environment requirements. A reseller agreement covering UAE or APAC is unresolved and is the primary commercial risk. GrowthBook proposed a roughly 45-minute demo, trial access, technical support channels, follow-up materials, and pricing discussions. SQ Skill Group will provide requirements, and both parties will assess product and pricing fit before progressing with the proposal.

## Keywords
A/B testing, Self-hosted deployment, UAE RFP, Reseller partnership, On-premises integrations, GrowthBook licensing

Send product documentation (18:33)

**Sagar Patil**
Share RFP information (13:11)
Provide A/B testing requirements (13:42)
Provide integration requirements (18:33)

# Sales call with Jeffrey Post from Market Leader
Date: 2026-11-18 | Duration: 44.766666412353516m

## Summary
The discussion explored using GrowthBook to improve ROI and conversion performance on sales-driven landing pages, since no dedicated A/B testing tool is currently in place. Market Leader, SmartZip, and one unresolved third brand were identified for potential testing through separate GrowthBook projects. Jeffrey is expected to handle most test setup and interface work, but engineering support may be needed for SDK configuration, code changes, and integrations. Each site will likely require its own GA4 connection and corresponding data source, with metrics such as average order value, bounce rate, and click-through rate available for analysis. Market Leader uses Pardot landing pages and SmartZip uses ColdFusion, creating implementation considerations. Pardot compatibility requires validation because GrowthBook has no direct integration, while the visual editor may cause flicker. The proposed evaluation is to connect one site on the free platform, test the integration and workflow, and then consider expansion. The Pro plan includes three projects, 30 users, unlimited experiments and traffic, and two million monthly events; three seats were estimated at approximately $1,440 annually.

## Keywords
GrowthBook, A/B testing, GA4 integration, Pardot, Experimentation platform, Landing-page optimisation

## Action Items
**Dan Wathne**
Confirm GrowthBook Pardot configuration (03:28)
